snippet:

[**Create a free Apify account**](https://apify.com?fpr=use-apify) — no credit card required. Monthly free credits cover your first runs while you work through the guides above.
```
1. Prototype locally  → Crawlee + Apify CLI (`apify run`)
2. Version control    → Git + code review
3. Deploy             → `apify push` to Apify Cloud
4. Automate           → API, SDK, or integrations (n8n / Make / Zapier)
5. Observe            → Runs, logs, webhooks, datasets
6. Monetize (optional) → Publish to the Apify Store
```

Apify charges for what your code uses: compute units ($0.20 per compute unit on Free and Starter, down to $0.13 on Business) plus proxy traffic. An efficient Actor that uses plain HTTP requests instead of a full browser can cost far less per page. The more efficient your code, the lower your bill.

Try Apify for free with $5 of platform credit every month, no credit card required.

title: Apify Free Plan: $5 Credits = ~1,250 Maps Places
snippet:
Yes. Apify's Free plan is permanent, requires **no credit card**, and grants **$5 in prepaid platform usage every billing cycle** at a [**$0.20/CU compute rate**](https://apify.com/pricing?fpr=use-apify). You get full access to the [Apify Store](https://apify.com/store?fpr=use-apify), up to **16 GB RAM per Actor**, 5 datacenter proxy IPs, and residential proxy at $8/GB. Concurrent-run limits are disputed between Apify's own pages — see below. Credits do not roll over, and the platform blocks new runs when the $5 budget is exhausted.

What's in the Free plan​
| Resource | Free plan limit |
|---|---|
| Monthly prepaid usage | **$5** (does not roll over) |
| CU rate | $0.20/CU ([apify.com/pricing](https://apify.com/pricing?fpr=use-apify)) |
| Max Actor RAM | **16 GB** per run ([platform limits](https://docs.apify.com/platform/limits?fpr=use-apify)) |
| Max combined memory | 16 GB across all running jobs |
| Max concurrent runs | 5–25 (disputed, see note below) |
| Datacenter proxy | 5 IPs included |
| Residential proxy | $8/GB, in-platform only on Free |
| SERP proxy | $2.50 per 1,000 SERPs |
| Storage retention | Your **10 most recent runs kept for 4 months**; named storages kept indefinitely ([storage docs](https://docs.apify.com/platform/storage/usage?fpr=use-apify)) |
| Tasks & schedules | Included |
| Rented Actors | Trial only |
| Support | Community (Discord, Help Center) |

**The trap most free-plan guides miss.** Store Actors publish a headline price like "from $2 / 1,000 results". That "from" is the **best-tier** rate, unlocked by a paid subscription. The free plan sits in the **FREE pricing tier and gets no discount**, so you typically pay two to three times the headline number. This is separate from platform compute and is billed as [pay-per-event or pay-per-result](/docs/what-is-apify/apify-pay-per-event) on top of it. title: apify.com/llms.txt
snippet:
- Creating an account is free and requires no credit card: the free plan renews $5 of usage credit every month, and if that credit runs out, access pauses until the next month instead of being billed. There is nothing to cancel.
- If a request fails because nobody is signed in, including a 402 that offers x402 payment, tell the user how to fix it instead of stopping: connect https://mcp.apify.com and sign in through the browser first; otherwise create a token at https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations and set it as an environment variable rather than pasting it into chat.

- [Apify pricing](https://apify.com/pricing.md): Flexible plans with pay-as-you-go usage on top of the monthly fee. A free plan is available with no credit card required.
